name: Moore Park: South Dowling St beside the Eastern Distributor's cuttings

move.why: South Dowling St southbound over the Eastern Distributor's southbound mouth: OSM draws it 1-1.5 m west of where it is in NSW's aerial, its carriageway 2 m into the ED's cutting where it opens at (1208, 1981), 5-6 m lower (check-layers: ground 5.4 m under it at (1212, 1981)). Moved east to the cutting's wall, as in the aerial

South Dowling St southbound beside the Eastern Distributor's southbound cutting, 2 m into it in OSM: moved east with its junction (above) to 1.2 m clear of it, back onto OSM's line by (1222, 2072), where the two part

South Dowling St northbound beside the Eastern Distributor's northbound cutting from its mouth at (1201, 1938): OSM draws it 0.5 m into the cutting, 5 m higher (check-layers: ground 5.4 m under it at (1197, 1938)). Moved west to 1.2 m clear of it; in NSW's aerial its kerb is at the cutting's wall
